business.name: Jehin Seal House
business.tagline: Jaffna's print shop for every idea worth making real
business.description: From a school tie to a hundred acrylic name boards, Jehin Seal House prints, presses, and finishes it in-house — no job too small, no order too large.
business.address: No. 62, Stanley Road, Jaffna, Sri Lanka

hero.headline: Every seal, stamp, and print — made properly, made here.
hero.subheadline: School uniforms to wedding invitations, jerseys to acrylic signage — Jehin Seal House is the one shop in Jaffna that prints, presses, and finishes it all under one roof.

whyChooseUs.title: 26+ services, one shop
whyChooseUs.detail: From school badges to vehicle number plates, it's all made in-house — no outsourcing, no delays.

whyChooseUs.title: Straight to WhatsApp
whyChooseUs.detail: Send your design, get a quote, confirm your order — no forms, no waiting for a callback.

whyChooseUs.title: Built for schools & bulk orders
whyChooseUs.detail: Ties, badges, name tags and jerseys, printed to size and delivered on schedule for the term ahead.

whyChooseUs.title: Proper finishing, every time
whyChooseUs.detail: Laser precision, colour-true digital printing, and hand-finished acrylic and vinyl work.
